items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are mostly clear, but business logic uses single-letter names: `e, err := encryption.NewEncryptor(key)`, `h hash.Hash`, `w`. Exported API (Encryptor, LoadKey, Config, DecryptReader) has no doc comments. Some inline comments help, e.g. on the chunk format.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: LoadKey repeats the `len(key) != 32` + ErrInvalidKey check 3 times. The handler calls `job.Encryption.Validate()` and then LoadKey validates again. decryptReader.Read is about 75 lines with nested loop branches. EncryptWriter panics on cipher errors.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Decrypt does `make([]byte, payloadLen)` from an untrusted uint32 with no upper bound, so a crafted length can force a huge allocation. Magic constants: 32, 16, pbkdf2 10000 iterations (low). EncryptWriter has `panic(err)`. Errors are otherwise wrapped with %w.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: Required signature changes are done and callers updated. storage.PathGenerator is left as `EnsureFileName(filename, gzip, false, unique)`, so storage callers can never request encryption, which is awkward but works. Unencrypted pipeline and filenames are unchanged.
